recheck.issue: Predict: option 'How many days each creative will last' is as defensible as the key, and the reveal misdescribes it.
recheck.reason: A per-creative time-to-event prediction can rank creatives too (segment index 2 visual already says 'Classification (or time to event)').

recheck.issue: Segment index 1: 'A ranked list wants the yes or no' overstates; time to event can rank too. Also 'censored' vs 'past creatives have a known ending'.
recheck.reason: First half right: the fixed window is the simpler route, not the only one. Second half rejected: 'running creatives' are not past creatives, so there is no contradiction.
recheck.change: Segment index 1: 'A ranked list wants the yes or no.' became 'For a weekly list, the yes or no is the simpler route.'

recheck.issue: Segment index 3 narration and visual present precision at the cut-off as measurable on planted incidents in unlabelled publisher data.
recheck.reason: Right that planted incidents check recall on known patterns and precision needs a hand-checked sample of flags. The narration only says the flag trades precision against recall and lists planted incidents among held-out rows, both true, so it stays; the visual made the misleading pairing, so the fix is there.
recheck.change: Visual row 2 'Judged by': 'Recall on planted incidents; precision from hand-checked flags'. No narration change for this finding.

recheck.issue: Quiz 7-5-q1 keyed option and why imply planted incidents measure both precision and recall.
recheck.change: Option 2: 'No answer column: define normal, set a cut-off, check planted cases and hand-review flags'. Why: 'planted incidents show what it catches, and a person reviewing a sample of flagged publishers shows how many flags are false alarms.'

recheck.issue: Quiz 7-5-q3: judging the edge against 'the wobble between backtests' is the unpaired fallacy.
recheck.reason: The course's own rule is the paired interval (facts regression.paired_differences: a difference whose interval includes 0 is a tie).
recheck.change: Stem: 'did slightly better on average, but it won only about half the backtests and the interval on the difference between the two crossed zero.' Why unchanged.
